data.narrative:
Wardstone is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $5M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Standard triangulation methods encounter binding constraints. Stage-Progression cannot be applied: the $85M base value proxy implied a post-seed valuation of $212M, exceeding 20x total raised and failing internal sanity checks. Peer-Median analysis is not feasible: while 14 same-sector private comps exist, only 1 qualifies as same-stage, with zero adjacent-stage or similar-tier comparables—insufficient for reliable median anchoring. Public-Comp Anchoring similarly cannot proceed: the public Space & Aerospace sector trades at a median 25.3x P/S, but Wardstone's revenue is not disclosed, precluding application of this multiple.

No triangulated valuation can be supported from the available data. The core impediment is the absence of either comparable same-stage private valuations or the target's revenue figure. Until additional financial disclosure or identification of tighter peer comparables emerges, a quantitative range cannot be responsibly derived. Investors evaluating Wardstone should anchor preliminary discussions to the $5M raised as a floor and expect valuation discovery during diligence.
